_comment: ADR-037 register fragment: version branches (lifecycle-git-branches, REQ-BQGB-001). Adds two properties to the existing ApplicationVersion schema and bumps that schema's version; nothing else is touched. The fragment's own signature already makes OpenRegister re-import the register. `branchBase` is where a branch started (the source version, the hash of the manifest it copied, and a snapshot of that manifest and of the schemas copied) and is the common base of a three-way merge. `githubBranch` is the Git branch a linked app pushes this version to.

branchBase.title: Branch Base
branchBase.description: Set on a version started with "Start a branch": the version it was branched from and what it copied, so a merge has a common base. Moves to the source's state after each merge.

source.title: Source Version
source.description: Slug of the version this one was branched from.

manifestHash.title: Source Manifest Hash
manifestHash.description: SHA-256 of the source manifest in canonical form, as hashManifest() gives it.

manifest.title: Manifest Snapshot
manifest.description: The source manifest as it was copied.

schemas.title: Schema Snapshot
schemas.description: The source register's schemas as they were copied, keyed by schema slug.

githubBranch.title: GitHub Branch
githubBranch.description: The Git branch this version is pushed to when the app is linked to GitHub. Empty for the production version, which pushes to the default branch.
